blurb: Good Time Dave’s Fishing Charters specializes in Pacific Salmon and Halibut adventures. With transportation provided to and from the marina, your Vancouver Island fishing charter will get under way in East Sooke (home of the big Chinooks) just a short drive West of Victoria, British Columbia.
